name: King's Road
note: A narrow cart track: Lumenfall to Greenhaven and the Golden Plains; crosses the Lumen at King's Bridge.

name: Northern Expedition Route
note: Ends at the expedition camp below Skyglass Lake (mountain pass beyond Frostwatch).

name: Eastern Trade Route
note: Toward the Hollow Lands; ends at the Hollow Gate where the climb into the corrupted highlands begins (that ascent is Phase 3).
